title: Sabine Wren
description: As a Mandalorian Warrior who spent the galactic civil war fighting alongside Hera Syndulla and the rebels of Phoenix Squadron to liberate the galaxy from the Empire, Sabine Wren wielded the Darksaber and helped unite the people of Mandalore. After the war ended, she studied the ways of the Force under Ahsoka Tano and, together with Hera, searched for clues that would lead them to find their missing friend Ezra Bridger. She was a talented graffiti artist and expert with explosives but had very little latent ability with the Force.
